left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Volleyball players
  -  Federated that at the time of the study compete in clubs of the Community of Madrid
  -  Over 18 years old

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Present a medical diagnosis of injury  [OR] or illness
  -  Have suffered a knee injury in the 6 months prior to the study
  -  Doing some pharmacological  [OR] or physiotherapy treatment external to the study
  -  Not signed the informed consent document
